name: orbi
description: Orbi: copiloto local que aprende os procedimentos pós-commit. Runtime (apps/runtime) + app desktop (apps/desktop) + contrato compartilhado (packages/contracts).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @orbi/runtime && npm run tauri -w @orbi/desktop -- dev
scripts.test: npm test -w @orbi/runtime && npm run check:types -w @orbi/runtime && npm run typecheck -w @orbi/desktop
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:chrome -w @orbi/runtime && npm run e2e:demo -w @orbi/runtime
